text: True or False: Edge couplers (inverse tapers) can be tested anywhere on the wafer surface before dicing, while grating couplers require a polished facet and work only at the die edge.
explanation: False — this reverses the two schemes. Grating couplers diffract light vertically and enable wafer-scale test anywhere on the die; edge couplers need an optical-quality facet at the die perimeter and tighter alignment. Grating couplers are -2 to -4 dB and narrowband; edge couplers are 0.5-2 dB and broadband.
